claim.claim-text: 1. Apparatus comprising:

2. The apparatus of claim 1, comprising a command generator unit (150) configured to generate a command signal (152) representing a vehicle control command for a vehicle (450a-f) carrying the apparatus (100) based on the first high-definition map (470).

3. The apparatus of claim 1 or 2, wherein a high-definition map (470, 132) the second high definition map is a map with a high information resolution and enables a vehicle to be driven autonomously and covers an area that is wider or larger when compared to a range being sensed with the sensor unit (120).

4. The apparatus of one of previous claims, wherein the processor unit is configured for renewing or updating data of the received second high-definition map in the first high-definition map by the sensor data with the fusing.

5. The apparatus of one of the previous claims, wherein the processor unit is configured for renewing or updating data of the received second high-definition map in the first high-definition map by the sensor data with the fusing, and wherein the processor unit is configured to update or to refresh only such areas or data objects in the second high-definition map (132) for which sensor data (122) is available.

6. The apparatus of one of previous claims, configured to communicate to a conventional V2X network and/or a backhaul network that receives and/or transmits information indicating a speed for the nodes in the network.

7. The apparatus of one of previous claims, wherein the receiver unit (130) is configured to receive data representing at least a third high-definition map; wherein the processor unit (110) is configured to fuse the second high-definition map (132), the third high-definition map and the sensor data (122) so as to provide the first high-definition map (470).

8. The apparatus of one of previous claims, wherein the processor unit (110) is configured to receive information (134) indicating a region of interest in the first high-definition map (470) and to provide the first high-definition map (470) so as to comprise a first degree of resolution in the region of interest and so as to comprise a second degree of resolution in a region outside the region of interest, wherein the first degree of resolution is higher than the second degree of resolution.

9. The apparatus of one of previous claims, wherein the processor unit (110) is configured to generate the first high-definition map (470) as a frame of the first high-definition map (470), wherein the processor unit (110) is configured to generate a plurality of frames of the first high-definition map (470), wherein the processor unit (110) is configured to generate the plurality of frames with a distance in time that is at most 10 ms.

10. The apparatus of one of previous claims, wherein the sensor data (122) is obtained by a scan of the periphery (304) of the device using an imaging technique, wherein the environmental condition is a distance to detected objects within the periphery (304).

11. 10. The apparatus of one of previous claims, wherein the processor unit (110) is configured to determine a portion of details (116) of the first high-definition map (470) relating to a traffic parameter of the apparatus in the first high-definition map (470), wherein the apparatus comprises a legacy interface (160) configured to transmit the portion of details (116) according to a legacy vehicular to vehicular, V2V, or vehicular to everything, V2X, communication scheme.
12. 11. The apparatus of one of previous claims;

13. 12. The apparatus of one of the previous claims, wherein the processor unit (110) is configured to generate the first high-definition map (470) so as to comprise a same coordinate system when compared to the second high-definition map (132).

14. 13. The apparatus of one of the previous claims, wherein the processor unit (110) is configured to fuse the second high-definition map (132), the sensor data (122) and a static map so as to provide the first high-definition map (470), wherein the apparatus is configured to not transmit the static map when transmitting a result of fusing (112) the second high-definition map (132) and the sensor data (122).

15. 14. The apparatus of one of the previous claims, wherein the processor unit (110) is configured to generate the first high-definition map (470) so as to comprise information indicating an age of information of the first high-definition map (470), wherein the processor unit (110) is configured to discount aged information (306) having an age being above a threshold value in the second high-definition map (132) when providing the first high-definition map (470), the aged information comprising an age above a threshold value.
16. 15. Method for generating fusing sensor data and a first high-definition map, the method comprising:

17. 16. Vehicle (450) comprising an apparatus (100) according to one of claims 1 to 14, wherein the vehicle (450) is configured to move autonomously responsive to a command signal (152) representing a vehicle control command, the vehicle control obtained from a command generator unit (150) configured to generate a command signal (152) representing the vehicle control command for the vehicle (450a-f) carrying the apparatus (100) based on the first high-definition map (470).
